covered.label: National Rail
covered.detail: Every train calling at Manchester Piccadilly, Manchester Victoria and this region's other stations, from the UK's national real-time feed.

partial.label: Manchester Metrolink tram
partial.detail: Only the line ends and a few major stops are listed so far (15 of about 99 tram stops), and the tram operator has no confirmed public live-times feed yet, so tram boards show an explicit message rather than made-up times.

stations: 19 stations and stops: 4 National Rail stations and 15 Metrolink stops. Manchester Piccadilly is the National Rail hub; Manchester Victoria is shown twice, once for trains and once for trams, since they're on different platforms in the same building.
